content:
We prove by induction that \(a_n=n-2\) for all \(n\ge 4\).

Base case: \(a_4=2=4-2\).

Inductive step: assume \(a_k=k-2\) for some \(k\ge 4\). Then
\[
a_{k+1}=\left\lfloor \sqrt{(k+1)a_k}\right\rfloor
=\left\lfloor \sqrt{(k+1)(k-2)}\right\rfloor
=\left\lfloor \sqrt{k^2-k-2}\right\rfloor.
\]
Since
\[
(k-1)^2 = k^2-2k+1 \le k^2-k-2 < k^2,
\]
we get
\[
a_{k+1}=k-1=(k+1)-2.
\]
Thus the formula holds.

Therefore,
\[
a_{2017}=2017-2=2015.
\]

\[
\boxed{2015}
\]
